acts.title: Flight school
acts.blurb: Six lessons, one control at a time: axis, engines, radio, gear and flaps, brakes, coffee.

acts.title: Green Wings
acts.blurb: Routine landings with the whole panel: traffic, fuel and the corridor tabs.

acts.title: The List
acts.blurb: Crew cards, fog, a trainee, the mountain bowl, storms and the valley where only eight crews may land.

twists.how: After FA.newGame, add param plane tokens to G.planes[2] (space 3, or the last space before the airport on shorter strips), never letting FA.planesOnTrack(G) exceed D.planeSupply.
After FA.newGame on a scenario with kero or leak, set G.pl.kero = D.keroStart - param (fuel starts lower).
After FA.newGame, set G.alt = "rb" so the altitude track uses the red/black side and the 2000 ft reroll token never comes aboard.
After FA.newGame, set G.rrHand = Math.max(0, G.rrHand - param) so the 6000 ft reroll token stays in the box.
After FA.newGame, set G.pl.axis = param (-1 or +1; negative = toward the Pilot), so the flight starts one notch off level.
Helper used only by easier offers: after FA.newGame, set G.coffee = Math.min(D.coffeeMax, param).

intro.text: Welcome aboard, Captain. Today you learn one control: the axis.
Drop a die on the axis. I will answer with mine. Keep her level.

outro.text: Level wings at the end. That is a good landing.

opponent.name: Port Alder Tower
opponent.personality: Calm dawn approach, a few parked planes on the river path.

intro.text: Now the engines. Two dice make your speed, and speed moves you along the approach.
Stop on the airport, never past it. Slow and steady.

outro.text: You stopped right on the runway. Well flown.

opponent.name: Port Alder Tower
opponent.personality: Calm dawn approach, a few parked planes on the river path.

goal.text: Reach the airport and land level.

intro.text: Planes wait on the approach. Leaving a space with a plane in it is a collision.
The radio sends them away. A 1 clears your own space, a 2 the next.

outro.text: A clear sky and a clean approach.

opponent.name: Port Alder Tower
opponent.personality: Calm dawn approach, a few parked planes on the river path.

goal.text: Clear the planes, reach the airport, land level.

stars.text: Clear at least 2 planes by radio

intro.text: Gear and flaps must all be down to land. Pilot has the gear, co-pilot the flaps.
Flaps go in order. I will take the first ones.

outro.text: Wheels down, flaps out. Textbook.

opponent.name: Port Alder Tower
opponent.personality: Calm dawn approach, a few parked planes on the river path.

goal.text: Lower all gear and flaps, then land.

stars.text: Clear at least 2 planes by radio

intro.text: Brakes decide how fast you may touch down. They start at 2.
Raise them to 4 and 6 with those exact dice, in order.

outro.text: You stopped well inside the runway.

opponent.name: Port Alder Tower
opponent.personality: Calm dawn approach, a few parked planes on the river path.

goal.text: Raise the brakes and land within them.

intro.text: Last lesson: coffee and rerolls. Spare dice earn coffee to nudge a later die.
A reroll token lets us both roll again. Then it is the full game.

outro.text: Every control, one landing. You are a captain now.

opponent.name: Chief Pilot Hedda Voss
opponent.personality: Fair but exact. Grades the full landing.
opponent.taunt: Not yet, Captain. Fly the check again.

goal.text: Land at Port Alder with every control.

twist.text: Help: you start with 1 coffee token.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest and you start with a coffee in hand.

intro.text: Foxmere at night. Planes queue on the approach and you cannot fly through them.
Radio clears one plane: yours counts 1 space ahead, mine counts 2. Any die value works.
Kestrel four-one, Foxmere Approach. Busy evening. Expect traffic.

outro.text: Runway is yours, Kestrel. Thanks for sorting the queue.
Every plane left on the strip is a crash. You kept the path clear.

opponent.name: Foxmere Approach
opponent.personality: Polite but busy: the traffic die keeps adding planes.

goal.text: Land at Foxmere with every plane cleared from the approach.

stars.text: Clear at least 3 planes by radio
Land with at least 1 coffee left

twist.text: Help: you start with 1 coffee token.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest and you start with a coffee in hand.

intro.text: Lake Orrin is a long flight. You start with 20 fuel.
Put any die on the fuel space to burn that much. Skip it and we burn 6 at the end of the round.
Low dice on the fuel space keep the tank healthy.

outro.text: Fuel left in the tank and the wheels on the ground. Good housekeeping.

opponent.name: Lake Orrin Tower
opponent.personality: A quiet night tower over a long lake. The fuel gauge is the real danger.

goal.text: Land at Lake Orrin without the fuel dropping below 0.

stars.text: Land with at least 4 fuel left
Land with a reroll token unused

twist.text: Help: you start with 1 coffee token.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest and you start with a coffee in hand.

intro.text: Seabright Bay is your first real test. The approach bends left over the water.
Marked spaces only let you fly on if the axis is tilted the way the tab shows.
Seabright Approach. I do not do second chances, Captain. Fly the line I give you.

outro.text: On the line, on the speed. Very well. Seabright clears you.
Act one done. Next season the weather gets a vote.

opponent.name: Controller Teo Vance
opponent.personality: Seabright Approach: precise and dry. Wants the left turn flown exactly to the tabs.
opponent.taunt: Off the line again. Go around and read the tabs, Captain.
opponent.praise: Textbook turn. You may tell them Vance said so.

goal.text: Land at Seabright Bay, matching the axis to every corridor tab you fly past.

stars.text: Land with a reroll token unused

twist.text: Help: you start with 1 coffee token.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest and you start with a coffee in hand.

intro.text: Act two. No more coaching on the panel: you plan, Ravi follows.
Castlemoor gives us two crew cards. Pick ones that save dice, not ones that look exciting.
Watch the fuel and the two corridor tabs over the old town.

outro.text: The cards are tools, not tricks. You used them like a captain.

opponent.name: Castlemoor Tower
opponent.personality: A gentle dusk tower among spires, with a fuel gauge and two tabs.

goal.text: Land at Castlemoor with your two crew cards and the fuel above 0.

stars.text: Land with at least 3 fuel left
Land with at least 2 coffees left

twist.text: Help: you start with 2 coffee tokens.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest, the boss rule is off and you start with 2 coffees.

intro.text: Swap seats tonight: you fly as First Officer. Ravi takes the left seat.
Your radio reaches 2 spaces. Foxmere is full of jets circling in the fog.
Foxmere Approach. Fog, holding stacks, and you have a trainee aboard. Good luck.
Use the trainee space early: all six tokens must be placed before you land.

outro.text: Out of the fog and down. The trainee is grinning in the jump seat.
Nice radio work from the right seat.

opponent.name: Foxmere Approach
opponent.personality: Fog, stacked traffic and a nervous trainee on the flight deck.

goal.text: Land at Foxmere in fog from the Co-pilot seat, with all 6 trainee tokens placed.

stars.text: Clear at least 4 planes by radio
Land with a reroll token unused

twist.text: Help: you start with 2 coffee tokens.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest, the boss rule is off and you start with 2 coffees.

intro.text: Bowlrock sits at the bottom of a ring of mountains. Only five spaces to come down.
Three corridor tabs, all leaning toward your side. And fuel to watch.
Bowlrock Tower. Most crews leave here with white knuckles. Show me yours.

outro.text: Down in the bowl and still smiling. I owe you a coffee.
Act two done. The last season is the one that makes captains.

opponent.name: Controller Gunnar Sted
opponent.personality: Bowlrock Tower: gruff mountain veteran who enjoys watching crews sweat the tight turn.
opponent.taunt: Too fast for the bowl. The mountains always win the first round.
opponent.praise: Hah! Dropped in like a stone and stopped like a feather.

twist.text: Boss rule: the plane starts tilted one step toward the pilot.

goal.text: Land at Bowlrock: a 5-space dive, three tilt tabs and fuel above 0.

stars.text: Land with at least 2 fuel left

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest, the boss rule is off and you start with 2 coffees.

intro.text: Final season. Your name is up for Cloudspire, where only eight crews are cleared.
First, Twin Spires: storm cells both sides, tabs that flip left and right.
Level the axis between tabs. Keep tilt small and we can lean either way.

outro.text: A bumpy one, but the passengers will only remember the lightning.

opponent.name: Twin Spires Tower
opponent.personality: Night storms between two glass towers; tabs swing from side to side.

goal.text: Land at Twin Spires, meeting every corridor tab, with fuel above 0.

stars.text: Land with at least 3 fuel left
Land with a reroll token unused

twist.text: Help: you start with 2 coffee tokens.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest, the boss rule is off and you start with 2 coffees.

intro.text: Palmreach is not answering the radio. Tail wind pushing us in fast.
The wind dial adds to your engine total every round. Tilt turns the dial.
And the spare reroll at 2000 feet is not on board today. Plan for it.

outro.text: No tower, no problem. That was all you, Captain.

opponent.name: Palmreach (no reply)
opponent.personality: A silent tower, warm rain and a tail wind that keeps adding speed.

twist.text: Flight rule: the 2000 ft reroll token is missing; only the 6000 ft one comes aboard.

goal.text: Land at Palmreach with the tail wind, with only one reroll token on the whole track.

stars.text: Land with at least 1 coffee left
Touch down at least 2 under the brake value

twist.text: Help: you start with 2 coffee tokens.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest, the reroll is back on the track and you start with 2 coffees.

unlock.text: First Officer Okoro, storm gear portrait

intro.text: Cloudspire. A narrow valley, thin air, and a 60-second clock every round.
Cloudspire Tower. Eight names on my list. Every one of them earned it.
A supply plane is on the approach. I will not move it for you. Land, and you're ninth.
Quick hands, Captain. Fuel, tabs, traffic. Together.

outro.text: Kestrel four-one, down and stopped. I am writing a ninth name.
Captain Marlow, line check passed. Every airport on the map is yours now.

opponent.name: Controller Aurel Kade
opponent.personality: Cloudspire Tower: keeper of the list. Cool, exacting, quietly proud of his valley.
opponent.taunt: Not today. The list stays at eight.
opponent.praise: Welcome to the list, Captain. Number nine.

twist.text: Boss rule: one extra plane waits on space 3 of the approach at the start.

goal.text: Land at Cloudspire against the clock, with fuel above 0 and every plane cleared.

stars.text: Land with at least 2 fuel left

twist.text: Help: you start with 2 coffee tokens.

easier.text: Ravi flies at his sharpest, the boss rule is off and you start with 2 coffees.
